title: Exact retained effect attempt
description: Record shape only. Rust checks identity and current admission; the host supplies independently established custody.

attempt_id.description: Derived identity of this execution attempt, distinct from its logical effect.

record_revision.description: Digest of the exact retained invocation and outcome; integrity is not custody authority.

consequence_id.description: Current action dependency identity returned by the core.

arguments.description: Exact effect-bearing values derived by the responsible owner.

effects.description: Exact effect scope admitted for the operation.

authority.description: Authority carried by the returned invocation.

source_owner.description: Admitted owner responsible for the operation.

expected_dependency_revision.description: Material source dependency revision of the admitted action.

operation_revision.description: Exact admitted operation semantics required to interpret retained results.

idempotency_key.description: Logical effect identity, unchanged by a recovery retry.

invocation.description: Exact owner-derived invocation admitted before the effect.

effects.description: Exact effect scope admitted for the operation.

value.description: Domain-owned committed value, never a current continuation.

outcome.description: Validated committed owner outcome, or null when completion is unknown.

target.description: Canonical workspace target to which this custody reference is bound.

path.description: Exact relative evidence path within the acquired workspace target.

owner.description: Responsible owner independently established by the host custody source.

revision.description: Digest of the exact acquired evidence bytes.

committed.description: Acquired immutable committed result reference, if available.
